_about: IndexNow (scripts/indexnow.py): after each deploy, new or changed pages in sitemap.xml and sitemap-people.xml are pushed to Bing, Yandex, Naver, Seznam and Yep. The key is public by design: the site serves it at /<key>.txt to prove the site is ours. A repository variable INDEXNOW_KEY replaces it. Change "resend_all" (any new value) to send every page once more on the next deploy.
